S.FORM: faki 男性長輩 例句:I cowa ci faki no miso? O tadaso^linay a rihadayay ko niyaro' no 'Amis, mafana' a mapapadang to demak no masamaamaanay a demak no niyaro'. Pakayni to raramod i, maolah ko kaying to pipaini no faki, pasifana'en no faki to cacicfayaw a demak, Ano maraod to ko pipararamodan i, o inato noya kaying ko mamipalimo'ot to wawa ningra.
S.PHON: faki **** **:i ʦo~uwa ʦi faki no~u miso~u? o~u taɬ~ɮaso~uʔɾinaj a riħaɬ~ɮajaj ko~u nijaro~uʡ no~u ʡamis, mafanaʡ a mapapaɬ~ɮaŋ to~u ɬ~ɮəmak no~u masamaamaanaj a ɬ~ɮəmak no~u nijaro~uʡ. pakajni to~u raramo~uɬ~ɮ i, mao~uɾaħ ko~u kajiŋ to~u pipaini no~u faki, pasifanaʡən no~u faki to~u ʦaʦiʦfajaw a ɬ~ɮəmak, ano~u marao~uɬ~ɮ to~u ko~u pipararamo~uɬ~ɮan i, o~u inato~u no~uja kajiŋ ko~u mamipaɾimo~uʡo~ut to~u wawa niŋra.
